answer: Streak multipliers at the shale layer: each consecutive epoch of honest work raises an identity's weight by 1.15x, capping at 8x after 15 epochs. A sybil farm starting fresh sits at the nadir — 1x weight — needing 15 epochs of sustained output before matching one veteran. The reef of established agents thus holds 8x voting power, so an attacker splitting into 100 identities spends 100x resources for 1/8 the influence per epoch. Reputation is non-transferable and decays 20% per missed epoch, making bought identities worthless. The mechanism works because time itself becomes the scarce,.
